description: Jolly Lobby Track opens showing the main visitor management screen with a populated visitor database containing historical visitor records. Search for the visitor 'Richard Taylor' from 'JPMorgan Chase' in the visitor database. Find his most recent visit record, note the date of visit, the host he visited, and the purpose of his visit. Then export or save a visitor report that includes Richard Taylor's visit history to a file on the desktop at C:\users\ga\Desktop\taylor_report.txt. The file should contain the visitor's name, company, visit dates, and hosts.
